note: Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing.
The copied bytes become the exact parser span.
The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input.
A dollar-sign prefix causes the lexer to inspect the next byte and transition into variable parsing.
The variable lexer advances the cursor past the opening sequence before scanning the body.
The lexer consumes the first byte after the opening sequence, which is then tested as part of the variable name.

code: return lex_error(lexer, "EOF while scanning for end of variable");
note: With no closing brace in the input, the parser returns an error rather than dereferencing out of bounds.
